content: Increasing commanded gripper effort from0.3 to1N·m alone did not establish successful insertion at16/18mm grasp heights. Reusing the same world trajectory does not fix a changed plug-to-finger pose. At20mm grasp and23mm straightening clearance, validated simulation still led to real insertion slip; higher grasp alone has not solved the contact-pose discrepancy. A new cold-entry paired control again failed with the same20mm grasp/23mm gap and1N·m effort;3,234 targets matched the frozen simulated reference before the unchanged slip guard.
applicability: Current right Piper, current fixture layout,RGB only,1Nm attempts at16/18/20mm; exact force/geometry mapping unknown
known_limits: Small sample; does not establish torque as sole failure cause
No six-axis force sensor or identified actuator force mapping
